# spice-usbredir / usbredirfilterfuzz

spice-usbredir's own fuzz target `usbredirfilterfuzz` ([source](source/usbredirfilterfuzz.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over usbredir (gitlab.freedesktop.org/spice/usbredir at f4406c50).

usbredirfilter_string_to_rules with fuzzed token/rule separators, then usbredirfilter_verify, usbredirfilter_print to /dev/null, usbredirfilter_rules_to_string and usbredirfilter_check against fuzzed device/interface descriptors; every result discarded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against usbredir at commit f4406c50.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch spice-usbredir` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `usbredirfilterfuzz.plain` | 306,272 | `c330482ba3f5784532cb208c817706b14449751c227b665eb37e94a7a4affd89` |
| ubsan | `usbredirfilterfuzz.ubsan` | 308,400 | `add3ce95fc6dcff38980d6876693b0827054f29ee29ed686ac9fc123e2d73361` |
| asan | `usbredirfilterfuzz.asan` | 809,896 | `03499e1f5ccaaa4f29bec74ea1193bab9a8197e181fb55b0b4f88585b60518a8` |
| asan-ubsan | `usbredirfilterfuzz.asan-ubsan` | 814,072 | `dc21d74fb4d3172392f726f99388e72054aeeeeb79795841cd94c7d7798d7184` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
